name: latent-vel-lock-sup
_notes: v5: learn to walk under the locks from the data first. latent-vel-free4 (no lock, no gliding habit) with the foot and ground locks on and only the supervised losses (no free runs, no counterfactual commands): the root now travels by the legs, and the recordings say what the legs should do (the lock reproduces 85% of their travel, scripts/lock_check.py). Every foot-locked fine-tune with free runs (free9 to free14) collapsed into stillness or a crouch instead of learning to step. Checkpoints kept at every validation for the stress battery.
